cards.quote: We're on track to ship by the end of the month.
cards.cn: 照目前的进度，预计能按期完成

cards.quote: The release will probably slip by a few days.
We're blocked on the API team, so I've reached out to them.
cards.cn: 被……卡住，要等对方才能继续

cards.quote: I'd rather under-promise and over-deliver on this one.
Who's going to own the next steps here?
cards.cn: 负责（某件事），对结果负责

cards.quote: We need to watch out for scope creep on this project.
cards.cn: 范围蔓延（需求越加越多，超出原定范围）
